subject: Concrete compute table proposal; real resource bounds now available
body: Propose new v2 only: set0 logical descriptor binding N maps table1 entry N for buffer/sampled-image/storage-image and table2 entry N for sampler, matching existing generic graphics table numbering. Never use Metal slot as N: Rust plan.descriptors.source supplies Slot(class,index,stage). Preserve combined image+sampler as same N across the two tables. Fetch/query without sampler must name a valid dedicated nearest dummy sampler in table2, never default handle0/table0. Reflection should carry binding,descriptor kind,access flags,array count/element and declared buffer bytes; require planner/compiler exact equality before import/dispatch. Dynamic descriptor arrays need explicit bounded flatten map(base,count,stride), not reuse N as element-index. Please compute+lowering ACK exact new header/max/table layout before implementing. Unspecialized corpus bounds are now resource-bounds.json and corpus_003: texture Metal index31 appears in both compute and fragment, up to22 distinct textures; compute31buffers+12samplers maxima. These are separate maxima, not one live pipeline. Existing arrays[31] reject slot31; explicit policy needed, never off-by-one/drop. Do not equate 1D with buffer texture; no buffer-texture declaration found in ordinary corpus.
